factors: Schema drift detected across all entities

top_risks.risk: Schema Drift — 2 column differences detected between source and target
top_risks.impact: Data loss or transformation errors during migration
top_risks.mitigation: Review schema mapping and update transformation rules

top_risks.risk: Balance Reconciliation — Variance between source and target balances
top_risks.mitigation: Investigate balance transformation logic and correct discrepancies

top_risks.risk: Row Count Mismatch — Source and target record counts differ
top_risks.mitigation: Review extraction query and ensure all records are captured

top_risks.risk: Permission Errors — Engine unable to execute full validation suite
top_risks.mitigation: Grant necessary database permissions to engine service account

go_no_go.reason: Critical issues detected — schema drift and balance reconciliation failures must be resolved before pilot
minimum_requirements: Grant engine permissions for full validation
